text: Tap the barn to slide the doors open. Tap again to meet who's inside!
Cow! Moo, moo! Cows munch on grass.
Can you make a gentle moo?
Pig! Oink, oink! A pig uses its snout to explore.
Can you wiggle your nose like a pig?
Chicken! Cluck, cluck! Chickens have feathers and two feet.
Can you flap your arms like little wings?
Turkey! Look at that fan-shaped tail.
Can you spread your fingers like tail feathers?
Sheep! Baa, baa! A sheep has a woolly coat.
Can you make a soft baa?
Rabbit! Look at those long ears. Rabbits can hop.
Can you make two fingers hop on your hand?
Horse! Neigh, neigh! Horses have hooves.
Can you pat your knees to make a clip-clop beat?
Goat! Goats are curious animals that like to climb.
Can you pretend your fingers are climbing a little hill?
Duck! Quack, quack! Ducks have wide, webbed feet for swimming.
Can you paddle your hands like a swimming duck?
Cat! Meow, meow! A cat has whiskers beside its nose.
Can you point beside your nose where whiskers would be?
Dog! Woof, woof! Some dogs help farmers look after sheep.
Can you give our farm dog a friendly wave?
Calf! A calf is a baby cow.
Can you say hello to the little calf?
Foal! A foal is a baby horse.
Can you make a tiny clip-clop with your fingers?
Lamb! A lamb is a baby sheep.
Can you make a little baa for the lamb?
Chick! Peep, peep! A chick is a baby chicken.
Can you say peep, peep in a tiny voice?
Kitten! A kitten is a baby cat.
Can you make a little meow?
Puppy! A puppy is a baby dog.
Can you give the puppy a little woof?
Farmer! Farmers care for animals and grow food.
Can you pretend to sprinkle seeds in the soil?
Tractor! Farmers drive tractors to help with heavy jobs.
Can you turn a pretend steering wheel?
